additional_info.subject: internal EVSE temperature exceeded lower limit
RE: AW: 0374030 - ID0374030-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R3 170001560]Display dark & unresponsive CRM:02023000089
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-DE Team,
I hope you are doing well.
I am checking in regarding the HMI replacement. Has it been thoroughly tested to confirm it is functioning correctly?
As you reported that the green lights are not running, please refer below KA troubleshooting steps.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: eMobility_SICD_HW_LEDStrips_Malfunction - (dynamics.com)
We are currently seeing an active error flag indicating that the internal EVSE temperature has exceeded the lower limit.
it could be because of following reasons:
internal EVSE temperature exceeded lower limit
Error flag is set to true, if temperature is between -40 and -25°C for more than 5 sec
Error flag is currently only reset by a charger reboot → bug fix needed
we have observed that BT3 & BT4 sensors are exceeding the temp values (highlighted in below image) kindly check the sensors wiring and also, we recommend carrying spare sensor of BT3 & BT4 if needs to be replaced at site.

additional_info.subject: 0374030 - ID0374030-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / R3 170001560]Display dark & unresponsive CRM:00472000199
additional_info.body:
Hello RC-DE Team,
Unfortunately, you are looking/replacing the wrong temperature sensor.
As you can see, BT1 is showing very different values from the rest of temperature sensors. Even the humidity is very different from BT2 which is not normal and looks a malfunction from the sensor itself.
First of all, you should measure the signal and look for any loose connections. The voltage range is between 1 to 10 V DC, you can measure BT2 and compare the results.
If the temperature/humidity sensor is damaged, please proceed to replace it. Be aware that the sensor type is different from BT3.
MLFB: 8EM5903-0AA00-1AA2 Temperature-/ Humidity- Sensor 24VDC
Reach out to me in case you have questions.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso

additional_info.body:
Hello Rudi,
Following our meeting today, where I received feedback on the charger's activity history, we have decided to schedule an intervention for next week. The intervention will involve a complete measurement and reconnection of the temperature sensors. Additionally, we will interchange the BT1 and BT2 input signals on the LOGO PLC to determine if the issue stems from the temperature sensor or the LOGO's analog input. Given the urgency of the matter, I suggest bringing a spare LOGO and an extra temperature/humidity sensor.
MLFBs:
6AG1052-2MD08-7BA1 - LOGO! 12/24RCEO 8xDI 4xDA Ext. Temp.
8EM5903-0AA00-1AA2 - Temperature-/ Humidity- Sensor 24VDC
Note: Please except for 18 of September, book a day next week for the intervention and send me the invitation.
